hint.unauthorized: Unlock the device and tap “Allow” on the “Allow USB debugging?” prompt.
hint.offline: The device is not responding. Unplug the cable and plug it back in.

empty.title: No devices connected
empty.lead: Connect an Android phone or tablet over USB. If it doesn't show up, check that:
empty.debugging: USB debugging is on in Settings › Developer options.
empty.cable: The cable carries data. Some cables only charge.
empty.driver: On Windows, the manufacturer's USB driver is installed.
empty.unlocked: The device is unlocked the first time you connect it, so you can accept the authorization prompt.

conflict.title: Another adb server is already running
conflict.body: It is version {{server}}, and Spiegel uses version {{client}}. Devices still show up, but Sessions may fail.
conflict.restartNote: Other programs that use adb lose their connection for a few seconds.

settings.title: Settings
settings.adbLead: Spiegel ships its own adb. Only use another one if you already have adb installed and want both programs to share the same server.
